issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 issue reporting that the example Composition document class value set at http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/doc-classcodes appeared invalid because LOINC search did not find LP173387-4 and similar LOINC Part codes.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-10509 was found. Jira comments show the issue was resolved by LOINC: LP173387-4 was confirmed as a valid LOINC Part from the Document Ontology File, and loinc.org detail pages for the relevant Part codes were later fixed.
additional_context: The historical LP-code value set was introduced by #8057 and renamed from doc-classcodes to doc-categorycodes when Composition.class became Composition.category. Current Composition is in build scope, but Composition.category now binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/referenced-item-category. FHIR-11907, a later same-family issue about replacing the old LP-code list, is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the seed issue's stated LOINC link-resolution outcome is satisfied and the current authoritative Composition.category binding has moved away from the old value set that triggered the report.
